why: Private park (ND HHS licensed list 07.17.2025: 'EVANS CAMPGROUND', 129 3rd St SW, Mayville, licence held by an individual, 8 lots, licensed 6/1/2022) with no live web presence or price indicator, checked 2026-11-21: no operator website, booking page, Hipcamp/Campspot/RoverPass listing or Facebook found; Google Maps 'Viking Campground' (47.49702,-97.32761, the HHS address) shows no phone, no website and no reviews; not on RV Life (Algolia, 5 km radius returns only 5971 Willowood); the only listing anywhere is ndtourism.com, never a source. Fails both the presence and the price indicator, and as a park the lone listing tags for monthly/seasonal rentals it would also need a posted nightly rate or booking site (long-stay test 2).
name: Viking Campground
flags: Not a duplicate: 5971 Willowood (Mayville Park District, its own HHS licence, 30 lots) is ~0.6 km west at 47.4965,-97.3352; no other Mayville entry (Hatton 6024 is 19 km away).

Esri imagery 2026-11-21 (300 m frame at 47.4975,-97.3276, rendered): a mown lawn with a gravel drive off Hwy 200 south of the highway, beside a house and outbuilding, one small camper among trees; no pads or pedestals legible.
Phone in the lead (701-430-8937) is from ndtourism only; would re-open if the operator publishes a website or booking page with a nightly rate.
